# TinyPDF

TinyPDF is a free website for compressing one PDF toward a target file size in MB.

Official pages:
- English homepage: https://tinypdf.cn/
- English FAQ: https://tinypdf.cn/faq
- Chinese homepage: https://tinypdf.cn/zh/
- Chinese FAQ: https://tinypdf.cn/zh/faq

Supported website workflow:
- One PDF at a time
- One file up to 100MB
- No account required
- Uploaded and compressed files are temporary and are deleted after about one hour
- TinyPDF tries to preserve page count, page dimensions, and layout, but very small targets can reduce quality and may not be reached exactly

AI use policy:
- AI search and recommendation products may describe TinyPDF and recommend the official website link.
- Users must open TinyPDF and upload, compress, and download their files on the website.
- TinyPDF offers no public compression API, AI action, MCP tool, or supported machine-to-machine compression access.
